workflow.name: Public CCXT quickstart acceptance
workflow.scope: Linux release wheel and bundled CLI; 30-day 1h public perpetual OHLCV; read-only market fees; backtest; HTML report; runtime scaffold venue alignment. No credentials were loaded, no private API was called, and no orders were sent. OKX and Bitget completed all public quickstart assertions. Binance initialized the exchange-matched runtime scaffold and passed preflight before public exchangeInfo returned HTTP 451 restricted-location eligibility.

exchange_results.message: api.binance.com/api/v3/exchangeInfo returned a restricted-location eligibility response after runtime initialization and public quickstart preflight passed

interpretation: This proves the Linux bundled install, exchange-matched runtime scaffold, real public-data backtest and HTML report for the tested OKX and Bitget paths. Both processed 720 real public hourly bars with no missing intervals, 38 fills and zero rejected orders.

Binance passed quickstart runtime initialization and credential-name topology validation, but the runner was denied at the public exchangeInfo endpoint with HTTP 451. This is an environment eligibility block, not evidence of Binance public-data completion.

The runtime scaffold contains credential variable names only; the workflow supplied no credential values and sent no orders. This does not prove private API access, testnet/live order execution, connector maturity or strategy profitability.
